# Applestone Solutions

> Applestone Solutions provides smart vending machines, AI coolers, temperature-controlled lockers and the cloud software platform that runs them, for operators, retailers and vending OEMs.

The website (https://applestonesolutions.com) is a JavaScript app. Use the plain-text Markdown feed below instead — it is generated live from the site's published content.
